lang: Hebrew (English summary pp. 141-142 included in the PDF)
location_note: Ketef Hinnom, eastern slope of a hill above the Hinnom Valley facing Mount Zion; map ref. NIG 22135-50/63070-80.
notes: Two Iron II burial caves destroyed by a Second Temple period courtyard-type quarry; Late Roman cemetery (hewn and stone-lined shaft graves, cremation burials); Byzantine church rooms with plastered roof-water channels and a sunken plastered installation leading to the large cistern found by Barkay (cistern cited, not coded). Barkay's earlier finds cited; not coded.

features.subtype: two Iron II burial caves (destroyed by quarrying); Late Roman shaft graves (hewn with troughs, stone-lined) and cremation burials
features.quote: The excavation also revealed a Late Roman-period cemetery

features.subtype: courtyard-type stone quarry with partly quarried blocks
features.quote: destroyed by quarrying activity during the Second Temple period

features.subtype: plastered water channels L622 and L528 (slab-covered), built channel W108, and the sunken plastered collecting installation L529 of the church roof-water system
features.period: Byzantine (5th-6th c. CE coin under the plaster floor)
